title: 第7章 醒来的残酷第8章 不一样的人

第七章 醒来的残酷
“末将领命！”
徐荣抱拳领命之后，上前三步，挡在了秦岚的面前，对着涌来的这群家仆不屑的勾了勾手指……“呀喝！”一群家仆那里受得了这种激将，一起冲了上来。
徐荣不屑的笑了笑，伸手就抓住了冲在最前面的一个，一个膝撞就立刻让他失去了战斗力，然后徐荣直接把他抡起给砸了回去，乱糟糟的一起涌上来的家仆顿时倒了一起。
只是这一下，就没有人敢动了。这些家仆们也不是傻子，毫无疑问，这个人很强大，不是他们可以比拟的，就算一拥而上，恐怕也是被人打的落花流水，何况他的武器甚至都没用。
土毕站在最后，因为他是伤者所以没有冲上来，结果现在这群家仆十多个人中唯一站着的就是他了。徐荣领到的命令是把所有人打趴下，见到他还站着，就抬脚不紧不慢的向他走去，却没想到土毕转身就想跑。
啧……徐荣摇了摇头，反手一捞，背后的长弓就到了手中，甚至都没有瞄准，弓弦一张，箭矢飞射而出，正中土毕的大腿，只见他惨叫一声，直接扑倒在地，痛的是死去活来。
这一下，更是没有人敢动了，这人不但实力可怕，更是心冷手辣，说动手就动手，一点不留情……他们看到很清楚，土毕的大腿被箭直接射穿，恐怕没有几个月的修养，是难得好了。
秦岚拍了拍手，徐荣做的很好，这群恶仆，长期以来以欺负他这个主子为趣，虽然以前的并不是他，但是现在自己既然已经接管了这个身体，自然就不能允许他们生那种念头。“徐荣，把这里的所有人，全部打断一只手！！”
“启禀主公，这群无知刁民竟然胆敢冒犯您，就应该凌迟处死，以儆效尤。”徐荣却不满意秦岚的处罚决定，他认为太轻了。
“……按我说的做。”秦岚想了想，刚刚穿越过来就杀人，这可不是一个好现象，还是低调一点吧。
“是，末将遵命！”
“少爷，少爷！！我们错了，您大人大量，放过我们吧。”那群躺在地上的家仆一听，这不对劲啊，竟然要所有人都打断一只手，这样他们怎么干活？？顿时一个个赶紧爬起来求饶，但是，秦岚只是挥了挥手，让徐荣执行。
“嘿嘿。”徐荣很直接的把他们一一踹倒，然后大脚用力一个个的踩过去，顿时一片惨号声，于是秦岚看出来了，徐荣的个性有点残暴，果然是魔王董卓手下的将领，真是有什么将就有什么兵。
这些惨号声恐怕很快就会引来府里的其他人，所以，秦岚直接带着徐荣离开了，他的住处，在府中东边的小角落，原本是一个工人住的杂院，后来因为秦岚母亲的身份不太一样了，所以就单独腾出来给他们母子居住。说到底，其实还是一个破院子而已。秦岚回来的时候，他这具身体的母亲并不在，她白天依然还要做工，而且经常在两个夫人的压迫下干更多的活。
秦岚的房间里，干干净净，完全不像是一个十六岁孩子的房间，除了一张床铺和一张桌子，就只有一个简陋的衣柜，里面放着少少的几件衣服。叹了口气，身上的伤还是隐隐作痛，只是比之前已经好的太多，这是因为他升级之后，身体的属性被游戏改造了。
穿越的事情，现在仍然让秦岚觉得有点不可接受，所以他很干脆的让徐荣守在门外，不准任何人进来打搅他，自己则合着衣服躺在床上开始睡觉。希望一觉醒来的时候，已经回到了自己原本的生活……
不过现实是残酷的，感觉刚刚闭上眼的秦岚很快就被人吵醒了。
他的门口传来一群人的怒骂声还有徐荣的阻拦声，这破旧的房子根本挡不住这些声音。秦岚坐起身，想了一下，然后果断的决定去开门。门口处，果然不出所料，秦岚的三个姐姐一个不拉的全部到齐，尤其是大姐秦晴正在怒骂，她脚下还躺着两个家仆，一看就是企图强行进屋结果被徐荣打倒的。
“干什么？干什么？”秦岚懒洋洋的伸了个懒腰，“没看到我在睡觉么？你们懂不懂礼貌啊？”

“秦岚！！你这个该死的小混蛋，现在不得了了啊，你从哪里找来的这个野人，还让他打伤了家里的十多个仆人，他们不用干活的？今天晚上我们吃什么？”
“吃什么你也要跑来问我？你有手有脚的，自己不会做？好吧，就算你不会做，大街上遍地都是酒楼饭馆，你会吃不？要不要我来喂你？”秦岚当然不是以前的秦岚，他的脾气一点都不好，习惯了指使人的他又怎么能允许别人对他大呼小叫，所以他回击的很给力。
“你……你……”秦晴气的指着秦岚说不出话，烧昏了头的她竟然忽略了现在的秦岚跟以前不一样了。“你竟然敢顶我！！我看你的皮是又痒了是吧，下午老二抽你抽的还不够？”
“大姐。”旁边一直不做声的秦衾和秦笉却发现了秦岚的不一样，被秦晴一提，她们顿时皱了一下眉头，“这个傻子今天很不一样啊……”
“不一样？不一样好，正好我今天心情不好，看我把他给揍回去。”秦晴挽起袖子就要上前。
秦岚轻描淡写的看了她一眼，“徐荣，把她给我扔出院子。”
徐荣一抱拳，“末将领命！”
“有本事你来打我试试？”秦晴仗着自己是家里的大小姐，发威惯了，她挺着胸仿佛一只骄傲的母鸡，但是下一刻她就不敢置信的尖叫起来，因为徐荣已经大步走了过来，一把抓起她的胳膊，直接向外拖去。
“啊！！放开我，放开我！！”秦晴对徐荣拳打脚踢，不过她只是一个魔法师，所以徐荣当她是挠痒痒，走到门口，直接甩手一丢，秦晴就好像破布一样的被丢了出去。“啊！！！！！！秦岚，你个混蛋，我跟你誓不两立！！！”
虽然秦晴在院子外疯狂的喊叫，但是她终究不敢再进院子。
倒是旁边沉默的二姐秦衾，却突然笑了起来。
“你这个手下不错嘛，借我玩两天？”

Chapter 7 The cruelty of waking up
"The last general takes command!"
After Xu Rong cupped his fists and accepted the order, he took three steps forward, blocked in front of Qin Lan, and raised his fingers disdainfully at the incoming group of servants... "Hey!" A group of servants couldn't bear this kind of excitement, and they rushed forward together.
Xu Rong smiled disdainfully and reached out to grab the one who was rushing forward. A knee strike immediately made him lose his fighting ability. Then Xu Rong directly picked him up and smashed him back. The servants who came up in a mess suddenly fell together.
But this time, no one dared to move. These servants are not fools. There is no doubt that this man is very powerful and cannot be compared with them. Even if he swarms up, he will probably be beaten to pieces, not to mention that his weapons are not even useful.
Tubi stood at the end. Because he was injured, he did not rush forward. As a result, he was the only one standing among the more than ten servants in the group. The order Xu Rong received was to knock everyone down. When he saw that he was still standing, he raised his feet and walked towards him unhurriedly. Unexpectedly, Tubi turned around and wanted to run away.
Tsk... Xu Rong shook his head, and with a backhand move, the long bow behind his back was in his hand. Without even aiming, the bow string opened, and the arrow flew out, hitting Tu Bi's thigh. He screamed and fell to the ground, the pain was so painful that he could not help but feel alive.
This time, no one dared to move. This man was not only formidable in strength, but also cold-hearted. He would do whatever he said without any mercy... They saw clearly that Tu Bi's thigh was shot directly by an arrow. I'm afraid it would be rare to recover without a few months of training.
Qin Lan clapped her hands, Xu Rong did a good job. These evil servants have long been interested in bullying his master. Although it was not him before, now that he has taken over this body, naturally he cannot allow them to have such thoughts. "Xu Rong, break one hand of everyone here!!"
"My lord, this group of ignorant and cunning people dare to offend you. They should be put to death in early death as a warning to others." Xu Rong was not satisfied with Qin Lan's punishment decision. He thought it was too light.
"...Do as I say." Qin Lan thought for a while, killing people just after traveling through time was not a good sign, so she should keep a low profile.
"Yes, I will obey your orders!"
"Master, Master!! We were wrong. Your Majesty, please let us go." When the servants lying on the ground heard this, they thought something was wrong. They actually asked everyone to break one of their hands. How could they work like this? ? Immediately, everyone quickly got up and begged for mercy, but Qin Lan just waved his hand and asked Xu Rong to execute it.
"Hey." Xu Rong directly kicked them down one by one, and then stepped on them one by one with his big feet. There was a sudden scream, and Qin Lan saw that Xu Rong had a bit of a cruel personality. He was indeed a general under the Demon King Dong Zhuo. He really had as many soldiers as there were generals.
These miserable screams might soon attract other people in the mansion, so Qin Lan took Xu Rong and left directly. His residence, in a small corner on the east side of the mansion, was originally a courtyard for workers. Later, because Qin Lan's mother's identity was different, it was set aside for them and their son to live alone. At the end of the day, it’s just a broken yard. When Qin Lan came back, his mother in this body was not there. She still had to work during the day, and she often did more work under the pressure of the two wives.
Qin Lan's room was clean and clean. It didn't look like a sixteen-year-old child's room at all. Apart from a bed and a table, there was only a simple wardrobe with a few pieces of clothes in it. Sighing, the injury on his body still ached slightly, but it was much better than before. This was because after he upgraded, his body's attributes were modified by the game.
The matter of time travel still makes Qin Lan feel a bit unacceptable, so he simply asked Xu Rong to stayOutside the door, no one was allowed to come in and disturb him, so he lay on the bed with his clothes on and began to sleep. I hope that when I wake up, I will be back to my original life...
But the reality is cruel. It feels like Qin Lan, who just closed her eyes, was soon woken up.
There was a group of angry curses and Xu Rong's blocking sounds coming from his door. This dilapidated house could not block these sounds at all. Qin Lan sat up, thought for a moment, and then decisively decided to open the door. At the door, as expected, Qin Lan's three sisters were all present, especially the eldest sister Qin Qing, who was scolding angrily. There were two servants lying at her feet. It seemed that they were trying to force their way into the house, but they were knocked down by Xu Rong.
"What are you doing? What are you doing?" Qin Lan stretched lazily, "Didn't you see me sleeping? Do you know how to be polite?"
"Qin Lan!! You damn little bastard, what's wrong now? Where did you find this savage and let him injure more than a dozen servants in the house? They don't have to work? What are we going to eat tonight?"
"You have to come and ask me what to eat? You have hands and feet, but you can't do it yourself? Well, even if you can't do it, there are restaurants everywhere on the street, can you eat? Do you want me to feed you?" Qin Lan is certainly not the Qin Lan before. His temper is not good at all. He is used to instructing people, so how can he allow others to yell at him, so he retaliates very powerfully.
"You...you..." Qin Qing pointed at Qin Lan angrily and was speechless. She was so dizzy that she even ignored that Qin Lan was different now. "How dare you go up to me!! I think your skin is itchy again, isn't it? Didn't you give me enough dick slap this afternoon?"
"Sister." Qin Gu and Qin Yan, who had been silent next to them, noticed that Qin Lan was different. When Qin Qing mentioned it, they frowned, "This fool is very different today..."
"Different? Different is good. I happen to be in a bad mood today. Let me beat him back." Qin Qing rolled up her sleeves and was about to step forward.
Qin Lan glanced at her lightly and said, "Xu Rong, throw her out of the yard."
Xu Rong cupped his fists and said, "The last general takes orders!"
"Come and try to beat me if you can?" Qin Qing took advantage of the fact that she was the eldest lady in the family and was used to showing off her power. She puffed out her chest like a proud hen, but the next moment she screamed in disbelief because Xu Rong had already strode over, grabbed her arm and dragged her away directly.
"Ah!! Let me go, let me go!!" Qin Qing punched and kicked Xu Rong, but she was just a magician, so Xu Rong thought she was tickling her, walked to the door, and threw Qin Qing out like a rag. "Ah!!!!!! Qin Lan, you bastard, I swear we are not at odds with you!!!"
Although Qin Qing shouted crazily outside the yard, she did not dare to enter the yard again.
On the other hand, the second sister Qin Gu, who was silent next to her, suddenly laughed.
"You are a good subordinate. Can you let me play for two days?"
